question: Actions of cholecystokinin include which one of the following?

options.opb: Secretion of pancreatic juice rich in enzymes

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Cholecystokinin released" -> "stimulates gallbladder contraction" -> "bile release into the intestine" -> "facilitates fat digestion" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Cholecystokinin released" -> "stimulates pancreatic acinar cells" -> "secretion of pancreatic juice rich in enzymes" -> "enhances digestion of macronutrients" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Cholecystokinin released" -> "increases secretion of enterokinase" -> "activates trypsinogen to trypsin" -> "promotes protein digestion" -> 85%

CHAIN: "Cholecystokinin has multiple actions" -> "includes gallbladder contraction" -> "includes pancreatic enzyme secretion" -> "includes enterokinase secretion" -> "therefore, all actions are correct" -> 92%
analysis: Cholecystokinin (CCK) is a hormone that stimulates the contraction of the gallbladder to release bile, promotes the secretion of pancreatic juice rich in digestive enzymes, and enhances the secretion of enterokinase. Therefore, all the listed actions are correct.
